root_cause: The incident register and self-fix duty was enforced for skills only. The 59 edge functions had no countable coverage, so a new edge function could be added without any incident duty and the gap stayed invisible. A survey showed only a handful of functions write to powerhouse_runtime_events at all.
prevention_rule: The existing chat-learning preflight scans supabase/functions/*/index.ts, fails when a function outside edge_function_protocol.loop_debt_baseline lacks the INCIDENT_PROTOCOL marker, fails closed on edge policy drift, and reports the rest as visible loop debt in incident_self_fix.edge_functions.

evidence.survey: 59 edge functions; 0 carry the marker; 59 baseline debt; 46 contain catch handling, about 6 write to powerhouse_runtime_events.
evidence.local_targeted_regressions: 14 tests in the incident suite pass (4 new).

outcome.limit: The marker is a declaration, not proof that errors are written. Make scenarios remain uncovered.
